name: HEVN, inc
long_description:
If you're paying contractors or employees across borders, your options today are limited to expensive platforms like Deel. And if your payout workflow is even slightly custom, you're out of luck.

We've solved this by building an agentic payroll platform. Just give us your contractor's email, and we'll take care of everything: onboarding, paperwork, contracts, invoices, KYC/KYB, and payments.

We save companies hundreds of hours of manual work and enable them to build fully customized payroll and payment workflows.
